title: DeathCoords
description: Simple mod that sends your death coordinates when you die
body:
# **DeathCoords**

**A simple mod that fixes the most saddening part of your life, where you siddenly get exploded by the creeper and didnt see your coordinates before dying. BECAUSE this mod sends your coordinates of death to your personal chat (not broadcasted lol).** 

## **Usage:**

**Drop into mods folder, and thats about it**

**the best part is that its completely server side mod, works on singleplayer aswell.**

  
**Although on its own is dead simple, if you are willing for a little more vanilla+ experience, I recommend checking out my Keeper Allay Fabric mod: [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/keeper-allay-death-inventory-keeper-fabric](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/keeper-allay-death-inventory-keeper-fabric)**
